name: sathi-lagbe
description: Campus Ride Sharing Application - MERN Stack

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:server:ci && npm run test:client:ci
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:server:fix && npm run lint:client:fix
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules server/coverage client/coverage
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run test:ci

author: Sathi Lagbe Team
